title: Kind of Item Replaced: Haul-Away Credit Extra (Northgate Store and Online Orders)
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders.** The replacement haul-away credit on a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order carries an extra percentage for the kind of item replaced, read from the covered item category of the customer's most recent claim settlement on the records of Northgate Protect Protection Plans (administered by Keystone Protection Services) (where two share the most recent date, the one recorded first):

| Settled item | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| a major appliance, whose disposal needs a two-person crew and refrigerant or appliance recycling | 20 percent |
| furniture or fitness equipment | 10 percent |
| any other large item | nothing |

**Examples.** A settled refrigerator adds 20 percent; a settled treadmill or sofa adds 10 percent; a settled television adds nothing.
